item.text: {"verdicts":[{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0024-R02-E001","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0024-R02-E002","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0024-R02-E003","status":"rejected","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":["The excerpt begins with paragraph 39 and does not contain the claimed figures or parliamentary composition from paragraph 38."]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0024-R02-E004","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0024-R02-E005","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0024-R02-E006","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0024-R02-E007","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0024-R02-E008","status":"corrected","corrected_fact_summary":"Women were allocated one quarter of local-council seats, and the National Council for Persons with Disabilities was established to handle disability affairs and promote integration and empowerment, including women and girls with disabilities.","notes":["The excerpt supports the quarter allocation and the Council's establishment and mandate, but does not support the broader claim that women with disabilities held council leadership roles."]}]}
